summary: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness bundle that bridges Paper Desktop MCP functionality into native paper_* tools and design skills, with reconnect and OAuth auth command support.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily an integration bridge between DeepSeek Harness and Paper Desktop via MCP, exposing Paper design MCP operations as native DSH tools plus design skills and guide/context injection, with additional reconnect and OAuth command support for servers that require authentication. Core capabilities include tool invocation, screenshot/image attachment handling, and auth token workflow, so it is best classified as an external-services integration plugin with medium risk due network/auth/token state and external tool control.
